== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English Light original and [[Undercover (Errata)]]. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member article. Columns are Original and Decipher Errata only (Supplement and Appendix A match Glossary 2.0). [[Undercover (PC Errata)]] redirects to [[Undercover (Errata)]]. Do not transclude onto [[Undercover (Dark)]]. No Revised, Japanese, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the Glossary wording that changed. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
